title: chore(release): cut 1.23.1
context:
The v1.23.0 tag never published: release.yml refused the candidate tarball with "npm package
contains forbidden paths" because both inline package-path allowlists predated the
contracts/change-proof/*.json fixtures and the change-proof .d.ts entries that 1.23.0 added to
package.json "files". Nothing local ran that allowlist, so the mismatch surfaced only after the tag.

Admit exactly those paths in both allowlists, and add test/package-paths.test.ts, which extracts the
workflow's own allowedPath
decision: Changed .github/workflows, test/package-paths.test.ts, tooling/changelog-locales.mjs: added predicate; new dep(s): node:assert/strict, node:child_process, node:fs, node:test; 1 new file(s).
consequences: Adds dependency: node:assert/strict, node:child_process, node:fs, node:test.
